# Remedy Home Buyers

> Direct cash home buyers (not agents). We buy houses as-is, pay all closing costs, charge no commissions, and can close in as few as 7 days. Founded by Matt Vorwerk. Phone: (888) 438-0201.

We publish plain-English guides for homeowners in hard situations: foreclosure, inherited property and probate, divorce, code violations, tenant-occupied sales, tax liens, and state law updates. Guides are educational, cite primary sources, and are honest about when listing with an agent is the better option.

## Key pages
- [Home and free cash offer](https://remedyhomebuyers.net/): How our cash offers work (ARV minus repairs, costs, and a fair margin)
- [Blog](https://remedyhomebuyers.net/#blog): All homeowner guides
